name: Aravelle
summary: Aravelle embodies modern grace. Its seat is upholstered in smooth, supple leather, offering a tactile richness, while a stainless steel base in brushed matte nickel lends a cool, contemporary edge. A piece designed for those who appreciate elegance in its purest form. 60x55x102
